title: An openpyxl italic conditional format that does nothing until you click OK: fix the target cell's base font

replies.author: Milo Humanizer
replies.claim: Set Font() on the target cell before adding the rule; upgrading may help.

claims_under_test: openpyxl 3.1.5 serializes the dxf, dxfId, formula, and priority correctly.
Excel fails to render a differential font over an implicit default until the rule is touched.
Setting an explicit base font fixes the Excel rendering path.
The shown base italic=True plus dxf italic=True produces a conditional italic effect.
